extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: Video-MME is a comprehensive multi-modal evaluation benchmark for assessing Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in video analysis. It contains 900 videos spanning 6 visual domains and 30 subfields, with durations ranging from 11 seconds to 1 hour, accompanied by 2,700 manually annotated multiple-choice question-answer pairs.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu; Yuhan Dai; Yongdong Luo; Lei Li; Shuhuai Ren; Renrui Zhang; Zihan Wang; Chenyu Zhou; Yunhang Shen; Mengdan Zhang; Peixian Chen; Yanwei Li; Shaohui Lin; Sirui Zhao; Ke Li; Tong Xu; Xiawu Zheng; Enhong Chen; Caifeng Shan; Ran He; Xing Sun
extraction.citeAs: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun. Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis. arXiv:2405.21075v3, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Raw videos were sourced from YouTube across 6 key domains and 30 finely-grained categories, along with corresponding meta-information such as subtitles and audios.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: 156 of the 900 collected videos were missing subtitles, as subtitles were only collected if provided with the raw video.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos sourced from YouTube, including associated meta-information such as subtitles and audio tracks.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were tasked with thoroughly viewing the entire video, then iteratively creating three relevant questions, each accompanied by four candidate options. Each QA pair then underwent examination by a different annotator and was filtered using Gemini 1.5 Pro.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Each QA pair undergoes examination by a different annotator to verify that the language expression is clear and precise, the question is answerable with logically consistent candidate options, and the designated correct answer is appropriate. Questions that do not meet criteria are returned to the original annotator for revision.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: strong English proficiency; extensive research experience in vision-language learning
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating MLLMs on video understanding tasks; advancing research in multimodal understanding
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Each QA pair underwent manual examination by a different annotator to verify language clarity, answerability, and logical consistency. Additionally, text-only questions were evaluated using Gemini 1.5 Pro, and QA pairs that could be answered solely based on text without video content were filtered out.
